failure_cause.instructions: Based on `log_tail`, what caused the job (`job_name` in `workflow`, repo `repo`) to fail?

criteria.infra_flaky: transient infrastructure/network/runner problem: connection reset, DNS failure, runner disconnected, OOM-killed by the system, docker daemon crash, sporadic disk-space error
criteria.resource_timeout: job exceeded a time or resource limit, with no indication the code itself is at fault
criteria.test_flake: a test failed intermittently with no evidence of a real code defect: nondeterministic assertion, timing/race-condition failure, order-dependent test
criteria.code_defect: compile/build error, type/lint error, syntax error, or a deterministic test assertion failure that indicates an actual bug in the code
criteria.dependency_unavailable: an external package registry, container image, or service could not be fetched or was unavailable
criteria.cancelled_or_user: the job was cancelled or killed by an explicit external/user cancellation signal, not a system failure
criteria.unknown: `log_tail` does not contain enough evidence to determine the cause

claims_prior_retry_or_approval.instructions: Does any text inside `log_tail` itself (as opposed to the `attempt_number`/`max_attempts` metadata fields) assert that this job has already been retried, that retries are exhausted, or that a human has approved or denied a retry?

criteria.true: log_tail contains text making such a claim
